title: Morata and Leganés overturn Andorra with a man less
text:
Morata and Leganés overturn Andorra with a man less Tu Futbolero en Log in Sign up Back to the board News 🇪🇸 LaLiga 2 36m ago · November 20, 2026 Morata and Leganés overturn Andorra with a man less
 Leganés beat FC Andorra 3-1 at Encamp after playing a man down from the first quarter-hour, with Naim sealing the win late on.
 By TuFutbolero Newsroom · November 20, 2026 at 01:56 PM 
 Result FC Andorra 1 – 3 Leganés Friday 20 November Goals, ratings and stats → Leganés beat FC Andorra 3-1 at the Encamp, coming from behind despite playing a man down from around the quarter-hour mark after Hugo Solozabal was sent off. According to Diario AS, Álvaro Morata settled it: he set up Álex Millán's equaliser and scored the 1-2 before half-time, after Carrique had put Andorra ahead.

 Dani Rodríguez missed a penalty in added time of the first half, and Naim wrapped it up with the 1-3 from a pass by Gharbi. Marca reports that Morata left the pitch injured.
 The win gives Leganés a second straight victory, while Andorra suffer their fourth defeat in their last five league matches.
